At least he’s consistent.
All of Donald Trump’s holiday messages are about himself. Why should Labor Day be any different?
Instead of saluting hard working Americans, Trump dumps all over his perceived enemies like a fat schoolyard bully with his back against the wall at recess.
If you’re depending on a weekly paycheck, can’t pay for gas or groceries, Trump does not care about you. Even some MAGA must understand that by now. The orange twit only cares about himself.
Here’s his “uplifting” decree of hate. Keep in mind he’s been convicted of 34 felonies, adjudicated a rapist by a judge and ordered to pay his victim around $84 million, and appears in the Epstein files more than anyone else.
Also last night “South Park” won an Emmy Award for mocking him.
“Happy Labor Day to all, including the Radical Left Lunatics, Communists, and Dumocrats who will do anything possible to destroy our Country. These Deranged People, after fighting for 10 years, should finally acknowledge that your Favorite President (ME!), knows how to WIN! They should be exhausted by now but, sadly, they’re not. They’re going to give it one last shot at ruining America, but we’re not going to let that happen. We’re going to win the Midterms, BIG, and SAVE AMERICA! President DONALD J. TRUMP”

President Trump, in typical fashion, wished everyone a happy Labor Day, slamming the American left as “Deranged.”
“Happy Labor Day to all, including the Radical Left Lunatics, Communists, and Dumocrats who will do anything possible to destroy our Country. These Deranged People, after fighting for 10 years, should finally acknowledge that your Favorite President (ME!), knows how to WIN!” Trump said.
“They should be exhausted by now but, sadly, they’re not. They’re going to give it one last shot at ruining America, but we’re not going to let that happen.”
